quote: Amazing game all the way through. From exploration to mechanics and fighting. NG+ is definitely worth it once you complete the first walk through and get your hands on the final bosses weapon!

quote: This game "Identifies" as GTA but it is not. My evidence to support my claim is that you can't do coke + can't kill hookers. I GTA'd 1 car after I've played for 8 hrs and was bored the entire time. No intro/tutorial should be this long or boring. Graphics are cool but that doesn't change the fun factor.
